object: British AI researcher and entrepreneur (b. 1976). Co-founded DeepMind in 2010.  Built AlphaGo, which defeated Lee Sedol in 2016 — the moment the shockwave from Solvay reached the general public.  AlphaFold solved protein structure prediction.  Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2024.
